english.title: Fail to notify change of keeper of unlicensed relevant Northern Ireland vehicle
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the holder of a trade licence, failed forthwith to notify the Secretary of State of a change of keeper of unlicensed relevant Northern Ireland vehicle
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 10 of Schedule 4 to the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002 and section 59(1) and (2)(b) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994.

english.notes:
Paragraph 10 of Schedule 4 to the Road Vehicles (Registration and Licensing) Regulations 2002 provide that on a change occurring after 30th November 2002 in the keeper of a relevant NI vehicle which is unlicensed, unless a vehicle licence or nil licence is taken out for the vehicle, the new keeper shall deliver to the Secretary of State the required declaration and the required particulars in relation to the vehicle,
(a) if he is a relevant vehicle trader, not later than the end of the period of three months beginning with the day following the day on which the change of keeper occurs; or
(b) in any other case, not later than the day following the day on which the change of keeper occurs.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit on prosecutions:
6 months
